title: Innovating to help pets stay with the people who love them
summary: Watch as we follow two veterinary clinics share the challenges they face and the opportunities they see to advance innovation in animal health.
body_markdown:
## Zoetis Presents, *Stay* .


At its heart, veterinary care is about helping pets stay with the people who love them.


Every day, veterinary professionals work to help animals stay healthy, stay mobile, stay comfortable and above all – stay themselves. It’s a pursuit driven by equal parts of compassion, expertise and unwavering commitment to finding better answers for the animals in their care.


Through interviews with companion animal veterinary professionals, Stay explores the many ways this purpose comes to life. And as these veterinarians share the challenges they face and the opportunities they see, we begin to understand what drives innovation in animal health. Not innovation for its own sake, but innovation inspired by the moments, relationships and memories that make the human-animal bond so meaningful.


Every innovation has the potential to help pets stay healthy, stay active, stay themselves and stay where they belong – with the people who love them.
